settings.title: Small-batch tinctures
settings.text: Spring water and 30% ethanol extraction. Made in the Western Cape.
Aspects of cognitive performance in small, short trials of Lion's Mane extract.
Exercise tolerance in older adults in small trials of Cordyceps preparations.
A long history of culinary and traditional use for Reishi, Turkey Tail, Chaga and Tremella.
They do not cure, treat or prevent any disease, including cancer, dementia, depression, anxiety or diabetes.
They are not a replacement for medical care or prescribed medicines.
They do not guarantee results. Responses vary and most studies are small.
They are not suitable for everyone: pregnancy, breastfeeding, mushroom allergy and several medicines call for caution.
